fields.tooltip: Which status this deepens when the wearer applies it. Weaken and Vulnerable are the two with a size to deepen - see Status.Amount.
On, only a summon with a Totem component gains the bonus. Off, every summon does.
Where this effect lands. Source aims it at the caster instead of the clicked tile, which is how one card can damage an enemy and buff its own player.
Nearest tile that may be clicked. 1 excludes the caster's own tile, 0 includes it.
Furthest tile that may be clicked. Ignored by Anywhere and SelfTile.
Movement only: the target must be reachable by walking within Max Distance steps, so a Wall of Force blocks the way. Off for teleports and for every non-movement card.
Used when Kind is Pattern. The painted footprint to stamp down, rotated to face the aim direction.

Flat adjustment to this entry's authored number (damage, shield, heal, and so on), applied before amountPercent. 0 is the authored number, unchanged - this is how an upgraded card variant (Slash+) deals more than the plain Slash it's built from without either of them needing its own effect asset. See ActionContext.Amount.

Percent adjustment to this entry's authored number, applied after amountDelta. 0 means +0%, i.e. unchanged - not a multiplier, so leaving this at its serialized default (a fresh entry deserializes to 0) never rescales anything.
On, this ignores index and matchesEffect and touches every entry on the card.

Used when allEntries is off. Which entry, by position in the card's effect entries. Out of range matches nothing rather than throwing, so a modifier authored for a 3-entry card does not explode against a 1-entry one.
If set, only entries using this exact CardEffect asset match - ANDed with allEntries/index, so 'every Damage entry' and 'entry 0, but only if it happens to be Damage' are both expressible.
